theorems.label: graph-distortion-line-w1
theorems.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides integer or real line distortion in time 2^(h(d)) B^(O(1)) on connected simple unweighted bipartite graphs when h is finite, nonnegative, and effectively o(d log₂ d).

title: An effective lower bound for bipartite line distortion
